scientific_question: At the hardest one-block DSMC budget, is the cross-condition weakness specific to the corrected U-Net, or can a parameter-matched modern restoration/operator architecture improve all four new conditions without target leakage?

architecture_notes.corrected_unet: The existing conditioned residual U-Net retained as a baseline, now with fixed physical condition scaling and a bounded residual head.
architecture_notes.nafnet_small: Eight full-resolution NAF blocks with SimpleGate and simplified channel attention, adapted to seven physical inputs and two residual outputs.
architecture_notes.mambairv2_tiny_adapted: A dependency-free parameter-matched adaptation of MambaIRv2 ideas: semantic prompt assignment, non-causal four-direction prefix-state mixing, local depthwise mixing, and gated residual blocks. It is explicitly not the full official multi-million-parameter MambaIRv2 network.
architecture_notes.fno_residual_small: Three two-dimensional Fourier layers with eight retained modes, local pointwise paths, and a bounded residual output.

condition_scaling.rule: fixed physical constants shared by every architecture and training seed; other channels use the single locked development-training split statistics

training.loss: pixel MSE + 0.10 gradient MSE + 0.50 lid MSE

promotion_rule.aggregation_over_training_seeds: arithmetic mean of condition-wise composite NRMSE over the three locked initialization seeds; sample standard deviation is reported

required_outputs: per-condition mean and standard deviation over training seeds
publication-scale T and u fields for every confirmatory condition
machine-readable CSV, JSON summary, recursive verification, and portable bundle
